title: ドラゴンクエストV 天空の花嫁
title_romaji: Dragon Quest V: Tenkuu no Hanayome
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots
The characters read off the pictures the game drew for them in play, each code paired with the glyph drawn the frame it left the game's queue

Played from power-on through the opening, round the ship, the arrival in port, the father's cabin, the gangway and the pier: what the script said in play agreed with the lines read off 48 pictures, over 9 scenes
and it read nothing on 9 screens that show no text; a question's answers (a yes and no box) aren't read
The table's characters were read in those pictures' sentences; of the 136 whose glyphs were kept, a second reader (an OCR model) agreed on 96, the 40 others each read in a sentence
notes: Read by the script games/sfc/SFC-F061BF93.lua; there is no layout. The game keeps no line of text, but unpacks its messages ahead into a queue of 16-bit codes, which the script reads. A speaker with no name is given as ＊, as the game draws it; the hero's name is read from where the game keeps it (plain kana only). The table holds only the characters met in play so far, the first quarter of an hour; the rest come out as U+FFFD. Where a conversation's first message has a named speaker and no second, the name comes out a character short. Menus, battle messages and shops aren't read.
